The '''MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser''', alternatively identified as the '''MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser''' or as the '''''Liberty''-class cruiser''', was a model of combat retrofitted [[MC80 Star Cruiser]] of the [[Mon Calamari]] that was used by the [[Mon Cala planetary defense services]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and the [[New Republic]]. Originally civilian vessels designed for luxury pleasure cruises and long-range exploration, the ships were converted into [[Heavy Star Cruiser]]s that went on to participate in multiple battles throughout the [[Galactic Civil War]], including a [[battle at Fostar Haven]], the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[Battle of Theed]], and the [[Battle of Jakku]].

MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were considered the standard MC80 model, of which there were two main types. The other model was the more heavily armed and [[armor]]ed [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]], which were precious to the fledgling [[Rebel Alliance Navy]]. Additionally, another [[Unidentified Mon Calamari Star Cruiser|type of Mon Calamari Cruiser]] was nearly identical to the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser, except for its lack of port and starboard wings. Several examples of the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser was the ''[[Liberty]]'', the ''[[Freedom's Dawn]]'', the ''[[Invincible Faith]]'', and the ''[[Restoration]]''.

==Characteristics==
===Manufacturing===
The MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser, also identified as the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser<ref name="Starships and Speeders">''[[Starships and Speeders]]''</ref> or as the ''Liberty''-class cruiser,<ref name="Battlefront II" /> was a class of [[Heavy Star Cruiser]]<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> that averaged 1,200 [[meter]]s in length,<ref name="BMF 24" /> with some reaching 1,500 meters<ref name="Front Lines" /> or 3,937 [[Foot|feet]].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> The vessel was the standard class of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser]], which included two main types including the larger and more heavily armed [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]], and was manufactured by [[Mon Calamari Shipyards]],<ref name="BMF 24" /> with examples costing 104,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> [[Unidentified Mon Calamari Star Cruiser|Another Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] was nearly identical to the ''Liberty'' cruiser, yet lacked the Liberty's port and starboard wings.<ref name="Episode VI" />

===Design and equipment===
[[File:MCLibertyTypeCruiser-SWE.png|thumb|left|300px|The rear of an MC80 ''Liberty'' Type.]]
No two MC80s were identical, as each one was built to an individual design for their original purpose as a civilian [[transport]]<ref name="BMF 24" /> such as operating as a long-range exploration or pleasure craft, designed for civilian use to explore [[the galaxy]] or carry passengers in luxury. Each ship was unique, and handcrafted to exacting specifications. Long and sleek with an organic silhouette, the winged vessels rivaled the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] in length, mass and firepower. Sturdy, well built, and over [[engineer]]ed, the Liberty could sustain the rigors of constant interstellar travel and take combat well. Cruisers could carry enough consumables to last two [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

The Liberty was considered to be perfectly suited for combat, which had always been a possibility in the plan of the original designer. Numerous water-filled passages that enabled [[Mon Calamari]] to swim to different areas of the ships, were drained and retrofitted with floors and ventilation systems, and thousands of viewports were plated. The holo-displays and battle graphics were designed for the visual spectrum of the Mon Calamari, as well as control stations that required body movements other [[species]] could not emulate.<ref name="BMF 24" /> The pale interiors of Liberty cruisers had multiple passageways and rooms, including a communications center, storage rooms, security rooms, and airlocks.<ref name="Battlefront II" />Some Liberties were already outfitted with a military grade [[deflector shield]],<ref name="BMF 24" /> and the combat and retrofitted Liberty cruisers maintained a [[deflector shield generator]].<ref name="Databank" />

[[File:Invincible-Faith-command-room.png|thumb|right|270px|A command room within an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser.]]
MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were equipped with nine [[M8.0 StarDrive engine]]s,<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> allowing the ships to reach sixty [[Megalight per hour|MGLT]]<ref name="Graphics" /> and 975 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]].<ref name="TFA Head to Head" /> They were equipped with a primary Class 1 [[hyperdrive]] and a Class 9 as a secondary. Long-range [[sensor]]s were also equipped on the vessels, with seven sensor nodules located on the hulls. Of these seven, four were topside nodules of which two were outfitted on the primary body, while the wings had one each. The remaining three were equipped on the ventral side of the hull, with two located midship and another one near the bow. The destruction of these sensors crippled the defensive systems of the cruisers.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> ''Liberty'' cruisers were extremely powerful and versatile, and also difficult to maintain as each ship was unique and component commonality was scarce between them. This didn't go unnoticed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as they would take caution on how and where they would deploy the cruisers.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> Liberty cruisers were outfitted with a ventral [[hangar]] bay,<ref name="Episode VI" /> although some models had a port-side hangar with a hangar door.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

===Armament and complement===
Beneath the surfaces were large amounts of heavy weapons, and because of their firepower and sturdy hulls they had surprised the Imperials on numerous occasions.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> The standard weapons of Liberties were retrofitted by heavy weaponry,<ref name="BMF 24" /> and included forty-eight<ref name="TFA Head to Head" /> twin heavy [[turbolaser]] batteries, evenly divided into twelve forward, twelve port, twelve starboard, and twelve aft batteries.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> It was also armed with twenty<ref name="TFA Head to Head" /> twin battleship [[ion cannon]] batteries, evenly split into five forward, five port, five starboard, and five aft. The cruisers lacked [[point-defense laser cannon]]s. Other weapons included six [[hull]]-mounted heavy [[tractor beam projector]]s,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> [[Missile launcher|missile tubes]] and broadside huge and heavy ion cannons that could perform heavy damages to enemy ships.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

[[File:MC80-Liberty-Ion-Cannons.png|thumb|left|280px|An MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser with port heavy ion cannons.]]
Although a full [[fighter wing]] of three [[squadron]]s, amounting to a total of thirty-six [[starfighter]]s, were used on MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers,<ref name="BMF 24" /> they could carry up to ten squadrons<ref name="UltimateSW" /> for a total of seventy-two.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> When using three squadrons, one unit acted as a reconnaissance squadron.<ref name="BMF 24" /> Other vehicles in its complement included numerous [[shuttle]]s, [[landing craft]], and utility vehicles,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> as well [[escape pod]]s in the civilian models.<ref name="Tarkin" /> An MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser's passenger capacity was 1,200 [[soldier]]s.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> On MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers with the port-side hangar bay, a broadside port opening was located behind the hangar. The opening contained a weapons control room with three large ion cannons with their barrels extending past the [[hull]] of the ship and a shield separating the opening and the exterior. These ion cannons could expose their inner cooling coils and cause explosive reactions when damaged.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

===Crew===
MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were staffed by 5,402 [[officer]]s, [[pilot]]s, and enlisted crew members.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> MC80 command crews usually consisted of Mon Calamari, and an MC80's starfighter wing was overseen by a [[Wing Commander]] who reported to the ship's [[captain]] and to the fleet's fighter command. Despite being designed for Mon Calamari,<ref name="BMF 24" /> other species including [[human]]s, [[Sullustan]]s, [[Quarren]], and others<ref name="Battlefront II" /> could serve as crew members following refits.<ref name="BMF 24" />

==Role==
[[File:SWA_The_Corellian_Conflict_box_art.png|thumb|right|270px|MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were usually accompanied by support ships.]]
Originally intended as civilian vessels for long-range exploration or luxury pleasure craft, refitted MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers served in the [[Mon Cala planetary defense services]] for the [[Mon Calamari system]] and its colonies. After further ships were retrofitted, the cruisers served as heavy [[battleship]]s for the Rebel Alliance, acting as a heavily armed starfighter [[carrier]]s,<ref name="BMF 24" /> [[command ship]]s, used for [[capital ship]] engagements,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and use as security cruisers.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers usually maintained a handful of support ships, as they served as main Alliance ships, they usually moved from objective to objective, operated as a base of operations for starfighter patrols, or protected vital Alliance assets such as [[shipyard]]s or high-ranking command staff. When in combat, an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser's standard tactic is to make a broadside strike against an opposing [[warship]]. If only one flank was exposed to hostile attack, the ship usually repositioned its shield to protect it. MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers depended on their starfighter squadrons for defense against [[bomber]]s, [[Patrol ship|patrol boat]]s, and [[gunship]]s and it lacked point-defense weapons.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==History==
===Mon Cala service===
The MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruisers were originally civilian Mon Calamari Cruisers operating as luxury cruise liners and long-range exploration ships. The [[Mon Cala planetary defense services]] utilized the cruisers for local defense of the Mon Calamari system and surrounding colonies.<ref name="BMF 24" />

===Alliance service===
====Early engagements====
[[File:AllianceFleetMidRimPriorFostarHaven-Squadrons.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Aurora'' and its fleet responded to a distress signal from Fostar Haven]]
Shortly before the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was an informal network of groups known as "the Alliance," Mon Calamari Star Cruisers underwent retrofits at the [[Telaris rebel stardocks]] to convert them into full fledged warships following multiple exoduses from their [[homeworld]], [[Mon Cala]]. These cruisers included the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'' and several MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruisers.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

In [[0 ABY]], following the [[Destruction of Alderaan]],<ref name="Date Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the prologue of ''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> the MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser [[Aurora (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Aurora'']] served within the [[Rebel Alliance Navy]] as the [[flagship]] of a [[Gial Ackbar's fleet|fleet]] led by Mon Calamari [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]]. The [[fleet]] consisted of eight [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]s, eight [[CR90 corvette]]s, five [[GR-75 medium transport]]s, and numerous [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s, [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s, and [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] from [[Echo Squadron]]. The fleet intercepted a distress call from an [[Alderaanian refugee convoy]] at the trading port [[Fostar Haven]], and members of Echo Squadron were dispatched to the location. Upon arriving, Echo Squadron was immediately engaged by an [[Rae Sloane's fleet|Imperial fleet]] led by [[Commodore]] [[Rae Sloane]], and needed reinforcements.<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref>

During the [[battle at Fostar Haven]], Echo Squadron called for reinforcements from the Alliance fleet, and the ''Aurora'' and several support ships arrived and engaged the Imperial [[flagship]], the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']]. Although losing a [[frigate]], the Alliance naval forces managed to rescue the [[Alderaanian]] refugees and the remainder of their forces escaped.<ref name="Squadrons" />

[[File:MC80_Battle_Cruiser_SWA.png|thumb|right|280px|Two MC80 cruisers and other vessels arrive at Xorrn.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War]], an Imperial naval [[Ralchio Nervi's task force|task force]] consisting of the [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Blood Ambition]]'' and the [[Raider-class corvette|''Raider''-class corvettes]] ''[[Sargantuan]]'' and ''[[Warhawk]]'', launched an invasion on the [[Ferra sector]] [[planet]] [[Xorrn]] against the [[Clan Assembly (Xorrn)|Clan Assembly]] and a group of [[Old Mandalorians]]. As a result, the Rebel Alliance dispatched a naval [[squadron]] to Xorrn consisting of two MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers and seven other warships. Although the [[Battle of Xorrn]] was already underway and the Empire was advancing on the surface, the rebel squadron, dubbed the [[Allied Armada]], arrived and immediately engaged the Imperial task force.<ref name="Friends Like These">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>

====Assault on Mako-Ta====
[[File:FleetAtMakoTa-2015StarWars50.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The Alliance Navy assembled at Mako-Ta, including scores of MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers]]
In around [[1 ABY]],<ref name="Date Mako-Ta">According to ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'', the Assault on the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] occurred around a [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]]. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the battle marks the beginning of [[0 ABY]], the Assault must take place around [[1 ABY]].</ref> several [[Standard month|months]] following the [[mutiny on Mon Cala]] that witnessed Star Cruisers from the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]] escape the [[occupation of Mon Cala]] and join the Rebel Alliance,<ref name="SW 49">[[Star Wars (2015) 49|''Star Wars'' (2015) 49]]</ref> at least twelve MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were present with the newly acquired vessels at the Alliance's [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]].<ref name="SW 50">[[Star Wars (2015) 50|''Star Wars'' (2015) 50]]</ref>

There, the Rebel Alliance Navy had completed the retrofit of multiple Mon Calamari cruisers with [[Shu-Torun]] systems, and had gathered Alliance leaders and ambassadors for the launching ceremony.<ref name="SW 50" /> Among the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers was the ''[[Liberty]]'' itself.<ref name="Ships of FO and R">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}}</ref> In total, around thirty-seven Mon Calamari Star Cruisers were present at Mako-Ta during the ceremony. Once the ceremony commenced, it was revealed that critical systems of the entire fleet were inoperable. At that [[time]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and his Imperial [[Death Squadron]], which included the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Executor]]'' and three [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]], arrived from hyperspace and destroyed the [[Unidentified Mon Calamari cruiser (Yavin's Hope)|cruiser]] ''[[Yavin's Hope]]''.<ref name="SW 50" />

[[File:ReturnToMakoTa-2015StarWars55.jpg|thumb|right|280px|MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers participated in the Assault on Mako-Ta.]]
Following its destruction, Death Squadron launched the full-scale [[Battle of Mako-Ta]] and bombarded the helpless Alliance warships, and when rebel starfighters were able to launch, Death Squadron released all of their [[fighter wing]]s to counter them.<ref name="SW 53">[[Star Wars (2015) 53|''Star Wars'' (2015) 53]]</ref> When the MC80A [[Republic (MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser)|''Republic'']] escaped after they received clearance codes and brought their systems back online, they returned to save the rest of the Alliance fleet. After the codes dispersed to the rest of the fleet, several MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers managed to jump into hyperspace and escape.<ref name="SW 55">[[Star Wars (2015) 55|''Star Wars'' (2015) 55]]</ref>

====Continued combat service====
[[File:Endeavor-SWA.png|thumb|left|260px|The MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser was a vital asset of the Alliance.]]
Following the [[Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the core of the Rebel Alliance Navy splintered into multiple naval [[division]]s,<ref name="SW 2020 1">[[Star Wars (2020) 1|''Star Wars'' (2020) 1]]</ref> including the [[Second Division]],<ref name="SW 2020 22">[[Star Wars (2020) 22|''Star Wars'' (2020) 22]]</ref> the [[Fourth Division]],<ref name="SW 2020 1" /> the [[Sixth Division]],<ref name="SW 2020 3">[[Star Wars (2020) 3|''Star Wars'' (2020) 3]]</ref> the [[Seventh Division]],<ref name="SW 2020 6">[[Star Wars (2020) 6|''Star Wars'' (2020) 6]]</ref> the [[Eighth Division]],<ref name="SW 2020 1" /> and the [[Eleventh Division]].<ref name="SW 2020 15">[[Star Wars (2020) 15|''Star Wars'' (2020) 15]]</ref> Although a number of divisions were lost, the Fourth, Seventh, and Eleventh Divisions were able to survive and join each other, and travelled to [[Panisia]] to rescue the Second Division. Already [[Battle of Panisia|under assault]] by the ISD ''[[Tarkin's Will]]'', the combined Alliance fleet force consisted of multiple warships, including at least two MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers and three MC80A ''Home One'' cruisers.<ref name="SW 2020 22" />

At one point an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser flew in the atmosphere of a terrestrial world alongside two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter]]s, while another MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser was plagued by faulty systems that went haywire and starfighters colliding on the flight deck, resulting in crew members being hospitalized. It was uncovered that the vessel was being sabotaged. In another instance, an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser attempted a strike at an Imperial weapons laboratory, and had to navigate through a sector of space that was full of dangerous hazards.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

====Battle of Endor====
[[File:MC80-Star-Cruiser-Frontal.png|thumb|right|175px|MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were selected as part of the Endor attack force.]]
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> after learning of the existence of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] at [[Endor]] and [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] presence onboard from information discovered by the [[Bothan Spynet]], the Rebel Alliance assembled the majority of its navy at [[Sullust]]. Near this [[time]], the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser ''[[Invincible Faith]]'' discovered a coded message from [[Moff]] [[Derrek Raythe]], revealing that the information was a trap for the Alliance. As a result, the [[Imperial Special Forces]] [[Inferno Squad]] infiltrated the ''Invincible Faith'' to delete the message. Inferno Squad's leader, [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]], allowed herself to be captured and brought aboard the cruiser, while her [[Dio|droid]], an [[ID10 seeker droid]], infiltrated the cruiser elsewhere.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

After the droid evaded Alliance personnel and reached Versio, the special forces commander freed herself and escaped the cruiser's brig. At this time, Admiral Gial Ackbar called on the ''Invincible Faith'' to join the assault on the second Death Star. Again evading Alliance personnel, Versio and her droid reached the cruiser's communications center and deleted the message, causing a general alarm to activate. Versio fought Alliance forces and escaped through an airlock, allowing herself to be jettisoned into [[Realspace|space]]. Versio's starship, the [[Raider II-class corvette|''Raider II''-class corvette]] [[Corvus (Raider II-class)|''Corvus'']], exited from [[hyperspace]] and picked her up, just as the ''Invincible Faith'' began to open fire with its heavy ion cannons.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[File:Alliance-Fleet-scrambled-Endor.png|thumb|left|300px|The Alliance Fleet, including MC80s, scramble during the Battle of Endor.]]
Eventually, once the Alliance fleet had fully assembled at Sullust and a [[Endor strike team|ground strike team]] infiltrated the Empire's defenses at Endor to destroy the [[Death Star's shield generator]] on the surface,<ref name="Episode VI" /> the fleet used the [[Sanctuary Pipeline]] [[hyperspace route]] to secretly travel there.<ref name="Moving Target">''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''</ref> The Alliance fleet at Endor consisted of multiple Mon Calamari Star Cruisers, including at least five MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruisers,<ref name="Battlefront II" /> along with many other combat ships. During the [[Battle of Endor]], the cruisers were to establish a perimeter around the Death Star II while Alliance fighter squadrons infiltrated the unfinished hull of the [[space station]] and destroy the main [[reactor]] from within. Upon learning that the deflector shield was still operational, Alliance forces broke away from their approach under the orders of [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]] and Admiral Ackbar.<ref name="Episode VI" />

At that point, the Imperial fleet revealed itself and launched its fighters against the Alliances forces. MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers took evasive action, and starfighter duels occurred throughout the Alliance fleet. One [[TIE/IN interceptor]] crashed into the ventral hangar of an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser and exploded during these actions. The Death Star II revealed that it was operational by firing its main [[superlaser]] at the ''Liberty''. The firepower completely destroyed the ''Liberty'', engulfing other rebel ships in the ensuing fireball. After the MC80A ''Home One'' cruiser ''[[Nautilian]]'' met the same fate as the ''Liberty'', General Calrissian informed Admiral Ackbar that they should move in to attack the Empire's [[Star Destroyer]]s at point-blank range. Although Ackbar protested that the fleet would not last long against the Star Destroyers, Calrissian believed that they would last longer and that they may destroy several of their ships.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:Dsiipown1.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Liberty'' is destroyed during the Battle of Endor.]]
At that point, the Alliance fleet engaged the Imperial warships at close range, as starfighters and bombers fought and crashed around the [[capital ship]]s. MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers engaged in broadsides with nearby Star Destroyers, and when the deflector shield was downed by the ground strike team and the fighters moved into the Death Star II's superstructure, they and other ships concentrated their fire on the Imperial [[flagship]], the ''Executor''. Soon, the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was destroyed by a crashing rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] and collided with the Death Star, as other Imperial warships were also destroyed. The Alliance fleet moved away from the Death Star II after its reactor was destroyed, and the [[battle station]] completely exploded after Alliance forces withdrew from within.<ref name="Episode VI" />

Following the destruction of the second Death Star, an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser travelled to the surface of the Endor [[moon]] and moved through its [[atmosphere]] as Alliance dropships arrived with more ground reinforcements, as the fighting continued on the surface. Inferno Squad, who was on the moon near the destroyed shield generator, managed to escape from the surface and travel into Endor's orbit. There, two MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers were travelling through the [[Death Star ruins]] towards a third MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser that was in combat with the ISD ''[[Eviscerator]]''. Once Inferno Squad repelled rebel forces and escaped, Commander Versio rendezvoused with the ''Eviscerator'' and escaped.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

====Operation: Cinder====
Shortly after the Battle of Endor, an [[Unidentified MC80 Star Cruiser|MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser]] led a small fleet of at least four CR90 corvettes and many starfighters to launch an [[attack on Fondor]], targeting the [[Fondor Shipyards]] and the ISD [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)|''Dauntless'']] that was docked. The cruiser deployed three [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] and opened fire with its large broadside ion cannons on the ''Dauntless'', but the transports were destroyed by Inferno Squad. On the orders of [[Moff]] [[Derrek Raythe]], Iden Versio boarded the rebel cruiser and wrecked the ship from the inside, taking out its armament and causing a CR90 corvette to crash into the ship. The ''Dauntless'' broke free of the shipyards and proceeded to fire upon the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser, causing multiple explosions and resulting in an Imperial victory.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[File:SWBF2_Battle_of_Naboo_Space.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser ''Restoration'' participated in the Battle of Theed.]]
Following a [[raid at the Wretch of Tayron]], the Alliance learned of [[Operation: Cinder]], a central component of late Emperor Palpatine's [[Contingency]] that involved the destruction of Imperial worlds, and decided to save as many possible.<ref name="Shattered Empire 3">[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]]</ref> Versio and her fellow Imperial [[agent]] [[Del Meeko]] surrendered themselves to the Alliance following a [[skirmish on Vardos]], and were brought aboard the MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser ''[[Restoration]]''. Following an interrogation, General Calrissian brought them to the cruiser's hangar bay and persuaded them to join their effort in stopping Operation: Cinder on [[Naboo]]. Successful, Alliance forces, consisting of [[Danger Squadron]], the ''Restoration'',<ref name="Battlefront II" /> and the ''[[Mellcrawler II]]'',<ref name="Shattered Empire 3" /> travelled to the [[Naboo system]] to reinforce [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]] attacking the [[climate disruption array]]s and the ISD ''[[Torment]]'', which had begun the [[Battle of Theed]]. While the ''Restoration'' fired on the ''Torment'' from a distance, starfighters destroyed the [[satellite]]s and engaged Imperial fighters. Y-wing bombers destroyed the shield generators of the Star Destroyer, and the ''Restoration'' fired multiple barrages that destroyed the ''Torment'', though not before it dispatched a wave of Imperial craft to the capital [[city]] of [[Theed]]. Ultimately, the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] and the Alliance prevailed and emerged victorious.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

===New Republic service===
====Final phases of war====
When the Alliance to Restore the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Republic|transformed]] into the [[New Republic]],<ref name="Aftermath" /> the MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruisers continued to serve in the new government's military, the [[New Republic Defense Force]]. An MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser participated in the [[Battle of Var-Shaa]] against the Empire alongside an [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] and an [[MC95E Star Cruiser]], along with supporting [[frigate]]s and corvettes. The warships managed to destroy the [[Var-Shaa dockyard]] and an Imperial Star Destroyer, forcing the ISD [[Overseer (Imperial-class)|''Overseer'']] and remaining fighters to retreat. Following the withdrawal, the cruisers moved through the wreckage of the [[Imperial dockyard]].<ref name="Hunted">{{EASWYouTube|f2VmOqjV_7Q|"Hunted"|int=Hunted}}</ref>

====Battle of Jakku====
[[File:Battle-of-Jakku-BF2.png|thumb|right|310px|Many MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers participated in the Battle of Jakku.]]
As the Empire continued to splinter into other factions such as the [[Imperial-Royalist coalition]], the [[Yomo Council]], and the [[Chadawan government]],<ref name="Victory's Price">''[[Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref> the ''de facto'' Imperial leader [[Counselor to the Empire]] [[Gallius Rax]] brought the bulk of the Imperial Military to the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] for the Empire's last stand against the New Republic. After the [[New Republic Senate]] voted to intervene, the [[New Republic Defense Force]] was mobilized and prepared to fight on Jakku.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> Ships of the Republic fleets, including many MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers, exited hyperspace and engaged Imperial naval forces in Jakku's orbit, commencing the [[Battle of Jakku]].<ref name="Battlefront II" />

While MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers and other Republic warships<ref name="Starhawk Armada">{{Armada|set=Nadiri Starhawk Expansion Pack|cardname=''Amity''}}</ref> attacked the Imperial flagship, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Ravager]]'', and its supporting Star Destroyers in orbit, other New Republic ships breached through the defenses and fought in the [[atmosphere]]. As MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers clashed with Imperial Star Destroyers in broadsides that destroyed many ships, starfighters and bombers fought throughout the area as New Republic ground forces commenced landing operations on Imperial sites, as well as rescue efforts for downed ships.<ref name="Battlefront II" />

[[File:Battle-of-Jakku-Eviscerator-Surface.png|thumb|left|310px|MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers clashed with many Imperial Star Destroyers.]]
Throughout the many fronts of the battle, many MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers and Imperial Star Destroyers were destroyed, with entire sections of their hulls crashing to the [[desert]] surface below. Other MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers that were destroyed crashed intact on the surface,<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''</ref> such as ''[[Freedom's Dawn]]''.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Many MC80 Star Cruisers continued combating Imperial forces as the ''Ravager'' fell from Jakku's orbit and began crashing into the surface.<ref name="Battlefront" />

Damaged MC80 ''Liberty'' cruisers continued to participate in the battle, even as other cruisers were targeted by [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]] and destroyed. The Star Destroyer ''Eviscerator'' was involved in broadsides with an MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser while New Republic Commander Versio, who had defected to the Republic, destroyed the ''Eviscerator''{{'s}} starfighters and bombers. Eventually, despite continued losses by the New Republic, the Galactic Empire's forces were eventually defeated.<ref name="Battlefront II" /> In the battle's aftermath, the [[Galactic Concordance]] was signed by [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]], ending the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="Empire's End" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MC80 ''Liberty'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser first appeared in the third and final installment of the [[original trilogy]] of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]], [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which was directed by [[Richard Marquand]] and released in [[1983]].<ref name="Episode VI" /> The cruiser's model was one of detailed miniature models created by [[Industrial Light & Magic]], along with the MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser. The MC80 ''Liberty'' cruiser's model was created by adding wings to an already existing model used for another [[Unidentified Mon Calamari Star Cruiser|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]]. The ''Liberty'' model was created to add more variation to the rebel fleet.<ref name="CineFex">[[Wikipedia:Cinefex|Cinefex Issue 13]]</ref>
